sources.note: Main homepage. Identifies Net Health as specialty healthcare software company (wound care, rehab therapy, occupational health). ~630 employees, 23,000+ facilities served.
Mandatory disclosures page for WoundExpert/WoundDocs ONC certification. JS-heavy, limited content extraction.
Additional Drummond Group certification page (the EHI documentation URL).
WoundExpert EHR product page. Purpose-built specialty wound care EHR, 25,000+ facilities, mobile wound imaging, automated documentation, analytics.
Wound care solutions overview. Comprehensive platform including EHR, analytics, and Tissue Analytics integration.
FHIR API specifications. Certified FHIR API supporting USCDI v3, HL7 FHIR R4, US Core IG, patient portal third-party app connectivity.
Wound care interoperability page. Describes integration capabilities.
Blog post about WoundExpert v7.0 ONC 2015 Edition certification via Drummond Group, December 2018.
Blog about Tissue Analytics acquisition (May 2020). AI wound imaging with FDA Breakthrough Designation.
2025 MIPS startup guide. Confirms quality measure/MIPS reporting support in WoundExpert.
RestorixHealth case study. Confirms partnership relationship and WoundExpert deployment across RestorixHealth wound centers.
PR Newswire press release for WoundExpert v7.0 ONC certification. Certificate 15.04.04.2815.Woun.07.00.1.181231, Drummond Group, Dec 31 2018. Lists certified criteria and eight CQMs.

Health IT Outcomes article on WoundExpert's top seven EHR interfaces: Cerner, Epic, HMS, McKesson Horizon, McKesson Star, MEDITECH, Siemens Soarian. Eight interface types: ADT, Billing, C-CDA, Clinical Documentation, Ordered Results, Scheduling, Transcription, Unsolicited Results.
FindEMR product page. Cloud-based SaaS, feature list (scheduling, billing, patient portal, analytics, integrations), user sentiment (strengths in imaging/documentation, weaknesses in stability).
SoftwareFinder review page. 4.5/5 stars (4 reviews). Target users: wound care centers, SNFs, hospitals, senior living. Pros: flexible, customizable. Cons: performance issues, complex integration.
WoundSource company listing. 30 years experience, 23,000 organizations, products: Tissue Analytics and WoundExpert, Pittsburgh PA.
Dreamit Ventures blog about Tissue Analytics acquisition. TA founded 2014, AI wound measurement <5% error, 2D/3D imaging, SMART on FHIR, FDA Breakthrough Designation.
RestorixHealth homepage. Wound care management company, 260+ hospital partnerships, 39 states.
RestorixHealth services page. References WoundDocs Specialty EMR with integration options.
RestorixHealth about page. Founded 1997 by physicians, wound care management company.
WoundDocs login portal hosted by RestorixHealth. URL paths contain /WoundExpert/ confirming same underlying Net Health software.
Casamba acquisition (March 2021). EMR for PT/OT/SLP and home health/hospice — separate from wound care product line.
Tissue Analytics product page. AI-powered wound imaging and measurement, integrated into WoundExpert.
